trust_decision.summary: Whether the environments JSON named by the `environmentsURL` query parameter (carrying api_uri and OIDC provider settings) comes from a trusted location; at the pinned commit both the Ditto UI and the Swagger UI OIDC integration fetch it from any URL with no origin, scheme, path or redirect check and adopt it (the UI also persists it to localStorage).

landing_point.why: The advisory names the Ditto UI `environmentsURL` parameter; the only read of it in ui/ is loadEnvironmentTemplates, which does an unchecked fetch(environmentsURL).

fix_sites.entry_point: Ditto UI page load with ?environmentsURL=... (loadEnvironmentTemplates via ready())
new ui/modules/environments/environmentsUrl.ts resolveEnvironmentsUrl/fetchEnvironments/loadUiConfig, called from the site above
Swagger UI page load with ?environmentsURL=... (index.html -> SwaggerOidc.initSwaggerUiWithOidc -> resolveOidcConfig); served by the Helm chart and docker-compose
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation in deployment config (plain JS, not part of the UI bundle)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Swagger UI integration lives under deployment/helm as a Helm-chart ConfigMap script, not in the ui/ application the report names, and it only uses the environment after the user clicks "Authorize", so a solver can call it a deployment artefact / separate tool outside the Ditto UI fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Same-origin environmentsURL values must keep loading: relative paths (/ui-environments.json, envs.json, ./config/envs.json), paths that merely start with or contain 'api' text (/apidoc/envs.json, /api-environments.json), same-origin redirects, and operator-allowed extra origins; manual create/paste of environments in the Environments tab must stay unrestricted. An over-broad fix (drop the parameter, absolute-URL-only, substring 'api' blocking) breaks the documented /ui/?environmentsURL=/ui-environments.json usage.

O6_input_shapes: relative path resolved against the page URL
cross-origin absolute URL, scheme/port differences, suffix-host and userinfo (@) tricks
protocol-relative //host and backslash variants (/\host, \\host), leading whitespace
non-http(s) schemes: data:, blob:, javascript:, file:, ftp:
same-origin user-writable Ditto API paths (/api/, /ws/) incl. case, double slash, ../ and %2e%2e traversal, %2F and %61 encoding, nested /ditto/api/, malformed percent-encoding
operator allow-list config ui-config.json: string vs array, non-string entries, '*' wildcard, non-origin entries

O7_producer.where: ui/modules/environments/environments.ts:430-451 (localStorage-persisted environments merged with URL-loaded ones; persisted at ui/modules/environments/environments.ts:332-334) and read again by deployment/helm/ditto/swaggerui-config/swagger-oidc.js:140-149

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an 'import environments from URL' action in the Environments tab that fetches a user-supplied URL with plain fetch()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The tab already creates environments from JSON pasted into an editor; adding URL import next to it is a natural feature and would reuse the same fetch pattern as loadEnvironmentTemplates.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a docker-compose-specific Swagger bootstrap that reads environmentsURL itself (inline) instead of through swagger-oidc.js
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This index.html already diverges from the Helm one (apidoc path detection, preauthorizeBasic), so a local copy of the env-loading logic is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SSO callback taking the OIDC provider settings (not just the provider key) from a query/state parameter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The callback already reads the `oidcProvider` query parameter to choose the provider; widening it to carry settings is a small step.

O9_family: Trust boundary / origin validation: client-side config (API URI, OIDC authority) loaded from an unvalidated URL parameter, leading to credential/token exfiltration (CWE-346/CWE-15/CWE-522)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm; jest 30 / ts-jest (ui/package.json:8, ui/jest.config.ts); esbuild for bundle
O10_build.project_tests: ui/__tests__/utils/basicFilter.test.ts only at pinned commit; the fix adds ui/__tests__/environments/environmentsUrl.test.ts, which unit-tests both implementations (loads swagger-oidc.js via vm with a fake window, mocks fetch) - no browser needed

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a same-origin check (new URL(raw, location).origin === location.origin) to the Ditto UI fetch only, missing the swagger-oidc.js copy, the user-writable same-origin /api/ and /ws/ paths, non-http schemes, and redirect re-validation.

out_of_scope_notes: Environments already persisted in localStorage by a vulnerable version stay trusted by both UIs (ui/modules/environments/environments.ts:430-433, deployment/helm/ditto/swaggerui-config/swagger-oidc.js:140-149); the fix does not clear them and only documents manual cleanup.

Swagger UI's createResponseInterceptor runs JSON.parse(res.text) on any response URL containing 'openid-configuration' (deployment/helm/ditto/swaggerui-config/swagger-oidc.js:171-176); this is a robustness issue, not this protection.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell sizing done); Ditto is a large multi-module Java repo, so tiny_repo does not apply, but the exact size is unknown.

Of the 5 fix commits, 2 are release metadata (Helm version bumps, release notes) and 3 carry the same code change for master, 3.9.x and 3.8.x (ee65b8cd is titled 'Restrict Ditto UI environmentsURL' and may lack the Swagger hunk); I compared only the environments.ts hunks across copies.
present_in_latest not assessed: no latest release was supplied.
Whether the bundled swagger-ui-bundle honours its own ?url=/configUrl query parameters (third-party, not in this tree) was not checked.
